## Description

Implements step 6.96 of `greenfield-fs` and the matching step of `brownfield-fs`: allowable-cost derivation from a market-price candidate and the resulting cost gap for the business case. Does not extract web-search price evidence beyond the candidates handed in. Use when: "target costing", "allowable cost", "cost gap", "target cost".
